spec.description: Citrix Machine Registration & Session Monitoring dashboard — converted from Splunk uberAgent dashboard. Uses Azure Data Explorer (KQL) against uberAgent data model tables.

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Catalogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Name_s
| project Name_s, SiteName_s, AllocationType_d, ProvisioningType_d, SessionSupport_d, PersistentUserChanges_d
| order by Name_s asc

spec.query:
Citrix_Catalogs
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Name
| project Name, SiteName, AllocationType, ProvisioningType, SessionSupport, PersistentUserChanges
| order by Name asc

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_DesktopGroups_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Name_s
| project Name_s, SiteName_s, DesktopKind_d, Enabled_b, IsInMaintenanceMode_b
| order by Name_s asc

spec.query:
Citrix_DesktopGroups
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Name
| project Name, SiteName, DesktopKind, Enabled, IsInMaintenanceMode
| order by Name asc

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Machines_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ('[[deliverygroup]]' == "*" or DesktopGroupDisplayName_s == '[[deliverygroup]]')
| where isnotempty(HostedMachineName_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HostedMachineName_s
| project HostedMachineName_s, SiteName_s, CatalogDisplayName_s, DesktopGroupDisplayName_s, CurrentRegistrationState_d, CurrentPowerState_d, CurrentSessionCount_d, IPAddress, AgentVersion_s, IsInMaintenanceMode_b
| order by HostedMachineName_s asc

spec.query:
Citrix_Machines
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ('[[deliverygroup]]' == "*" or DesktopGroupDisplayName == '[[deliverygroup]]')
| where isnotempty(HostedMachineName)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by HostedMachineName
| project HostedMachineName, SiteName, CatalogDisplayName, DesktopGroupDisplayName, CurrentRegistrationState, CurrentPowerState, CurrentSessionCount, IPAddress, AgentVersion, IsInMaintenanceMode
| order by HostedMachineName asc

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Machines_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ('[[deliverygroup]]' == "*" or DesktopGroupDisplayName_s == '[[deliverygroup]]')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HostedMachineName_s
| where CurrentRegistrationState_d == "1"
| summarize Registered = count()

spec.query:
Citrix_Machines
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where ('[[deliverygroup]]' == "*" or DesktopGroupDisplayName == '[[deliverygroup]]')
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by HostedMachineName
| summarize TotalMachines = count()

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Machines_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)

| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HostedMachineName_s

| summarize Registered = count()

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Machines_CL

| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HostedMachineName_s

| summarize Unregistered = count()

spec.query:

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Machines_CL

| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HostedMachineName_s
| summarize ActiveSessions = sum(CurrentSessionCount_d)

spec.query:

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Machines_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ('[[deliverygroup]]' == "*" or DesktopGroupDisplayName_s == '[[deliverygroup]]')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by HostedMachineName_s
| summarize Total = count(), Registered = countif(CurrentRegistrationState_d == "1")
| extend RegistrationRate = round(100.0 * Registered / Total, 1)
| project RegistrationRate

spec.query:
Citrix_Machines

| summarize Registered = countif(CurrentRegistrationState_d == "1"), Unregistered = countif(CurrentRegistrationState_d == "2") by  bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)

spec.query:
Citrix_Machines

spec.query:

spec.title: Citrix Machine Registration & Sessions

spec.name: deliverygroup
spec.label: Delivery Group

adx.query:
uberAgent_Citrix_Machines_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| distinct DesktopGroupDisplayName_s
| where isnotempty(DesktopGroupDisplayName_s)
| order by DesktopGroupDisplayName_s asc
| project DesktopGroupDisplayName_s = strcat('"', DesktopGroupDisplayName_s, '"')

spec.query:
Citrix_Machines
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| distinct DesktopGroupDisplayName
| where isnotempty(DesktopGroupDisplayName)
| order by DesktopGroupDisplayName asc
| project DesktopGroupDisplayName = strcat('"', DesktopGroupDisplayName, '"')
